knownBoundaryDebt.finding: domain_entities/domain_relations mirror business-domain state and are also used by resource authorization. Migration 065 materializes both work_request and work_order from every legacy orders row and adds a produces relation without verifying that a request was actually accepted into a RepairOrder.
knownBoundaryDebt.impact: The generic projection can assert a RepairOrder that does not yet exist semantically, contradict ServiceRequest != RepairOrder. If projection ownership is stale, resource authorization can also diverge from the owning domain.
knownBoundaryDebt.target: domain_entities/domain_relations are projection/ACL indexes only. Business aggregate existence and transitions come from the owning domain contract; projection updates carry source/version evidence and never create stronger business facts than the owner.
knownBoundaryDebt.migrationPolicy: Do not delete the projection. Correct projection semantics incrementally: distinguish request-only versus accepted repair state, add provenance/revision checks, backfill safely, then verify authorization parity before changing readers.

knownBoundaryDebt.finding: idempotency_keys stores request_hash, but kareta_idempotency_begin does not compare an existing row's request_hash with the incoming request before replaying/reusing the key.
knownBoundaryDebt.impact: The same idempotency key can be reused for a different payload in the same action/actor scope and receive the previous response or reuse the processing slot instead of an explicit conflict.
knownBoundaryDebt.target: Bind action + stable actor/context + idempotency key to exactly one canonical request hash. A different payload for an existing key returns an explicit 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
knownBoundaryDebt.migrationPolicy: Add request-hash comparison and regression tests before broadening idempotency coverage.

knownBoundaryDebt.finding: actor_hash includes PHP session_id, so idempotency scope changes after session rotation even for the same Account/context.
knownBoundaryDebt.impact: A legitimate retry after session renewal can bypass the previous idempotency record.
knownBoundaryDebt.target: Use stable authenticated Account/context identity in the actor scope, with legacy fallback only where Identity is unavailable.

knownBoundaryDebt.finding: runtime_health.php is intentionally non-mutating, but schema_health.php and identity_health.php load bootstrap.php; bootstrap can run schema bootstrap/migrations and throttled repair/backfill maintenance.
knownBoundaryDebt.impact: A health/readiness probe can have side effects, increased latency or couple availability checks to repair work.
knownBoundaryDebt.target: Separate pure liveness/readiness inspection from explicit repair/migration commands. Health endpoints may record telemetry only through a bounded non-disruptive path.
knownBoundaryDebt.migrationPolicy: Keep current recovery behavior until deployment/startup migration flow is proven; first add pure read-only probes and tests.

knownBoundaryDebt.finding: Normal bootstrap can perform schema-changing work when migration history does not match the expected version.
knownBoundaryDebt.impact: Application traffic can enter a DDL/recovery path; the database lock prevents duplicate work but does not eliminate request latency or deployment coupling.
knownBoundaryDebt.target: Production releases run deterministic migrations before serving normal traffic; runtime auto-repair remains an explicit emergency compatibility path.

knownBoundaryDebt.finding: Internal architecture audit is report-only and searches patterns, but the current guide/rules are not yet wired as mandatory CI/release enforcement.
knownBoundaryDebt.target: Convert stable P0/P1 rules into machine-enforced checks only after false-positive baselines and exception mechanics are defined.
